description: Make spend visible: a project-scoped agent cost rollup endpoint (totalCost, todayCost, doneIssuesCount, costPerShip) that fills the InvestmentPanel shell and wires the reserved today-cost slot in the factory-status headline.

tasks.title: Backend: project-scoped agent cost rollup endpoint
tasks.description: Add `GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent/cost` on the existing agent route group, composing `AgentSessionQuerier.GetCostRollupAsync` (totalCost via unbounded sum, todayCost via current-UTC-day window) and `IssueQuerier.ListAsync` (done count where status == "done") in the handler. Add `AgentCostRollupDto` / `AgentCostMetricDto` records next to `AgentUsageTimeseriesDto`. Compute `costPerShip` in the handler. The endpoint reuses the group's `ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter` (unknown project → 404) and returns 200 with per-metric empty/zero-sample state (amount null + sampleCount 0) for zero-sample cases. No schema change, no new data collection.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent/cost returns 200 with { totalCost, todayCost, doneIssuesCount, costPerShip } each carrying { amount, currency, sampleCount } where applicable.
totalCost is the unbounded sum of CostAmount over sessions with usage; sessions without usage are skipped (spec scenario 'Total cost is the sum of every contributing session's cost').
todayCost sums only sessions whose CreatedAt falls within [UtcNow.Date, UtcNow.Date.AddDays(1)); prior-day sessions are excluded (spec scenario 'Today cost sums only sessions created today').
doneIssuesCount counts only issues with status == "done" (spec scenario 'Done-issues count counts only Done issues').

costPerShip equals totalCost / doneIssuesCount; is amount=null when doneIssuesCount == 0 (spec scenario 'Zero shipped issues yields an undefined cost-per-ship'); is a genuine 0 when totalCost==0 and doneIssuesCount>0 (spec scenario 'Free shipping is a real zero, not an empty sample').

A project with no sessions with usage returns 200 with totalCost/todayCost as empty (amount null, sampleCount 0), not an error and not a numeric zero (spec scenario 'No sessions with usage yields an empty spend result').
Emptiness is evaluated independently per metric (spec scenario 'Emptiness is evaluated independently per metric').
An unknown project reference returns 404 via ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter (spec scenario 'Unknown project returns not found').
The existing GET /agent/usage 7-day timeseries endpoint remains available and unchanged.

Unit tests cover: multi-session total sum, no-usage skip, calendar-day boundary for todayCost, done-only count, costPerShip real-zero vs undefined, independent emptiness, unknown-project 404, and the no-new-collection invariant.
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) passes for packages/server.
tasks.output: packages/server cost rollup DTOs + AgentSessionQuerier.GetCostRollupAsync + AgentRoutes /cost handler + unit tests
tasks.notes: Follow design.md D1 (sibling endpoint on agent route group), D2 (compose two queriers in handler, no new service class), D3 (per-metric nullable amount + sampleCount mirroring QualityPanel convention), D4 (single-currency, first-non-null currency). The HasUsage predicate and AgentSessionJsonHelper.Usage are reused from the existing timeseries path.

tasks.title: Frontend: useCostRollup hook + fill InvestmentPanel with spend figures
tasks.description: Create `entities/agent/api/cost-rollup.ts` with `fetchCostRollup(projectId)`, `costRollupQueryKey(projectId?)`, and `useCostRollup()` (enabled: !!projectId, staleTime: 60_000), exported via `entities/agent/index.ts`. Then replace the InvestmentPanel empty shell with rendered figures: cumulative spend (formatCost(totalCost.amount, totalCost.currency)), cost-per-ship (formatCost or — when undefined), and done-issue count; keep a data-state="empty" block ('No spend recorded yet — …') when totalCost.sampleCount === 0, mirroring QualityPanel. Update the caliber basis string from 'trailing 7 days' to cumulative semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: useCostRollup() exists in entities/agent/api/cost-rollup.ts and is exported through entities/agent/index.ts; it fetches GET /api/projects/{projectId}/agent/cost with enabled: !!projectId and staleTime: 60_000.
InvestmentPanel renders cumulative spend, cost-per-ship, and done-issue count when the rollup returns a non-empty totalCost sample (totalCost.sampleCount > 0).
InvestmentPanel shows data-state="empty" with 'No spend recorded yet' copy when totalCost.sampleCount === 0 (no longer the old 'Data unavailable / waiting for hook' shell).
costPerShip renders — (em-dash placeholder) when costPerShip.amount is null (doneIssuesCount == 0), and a formatted amount otherwise.
A genuine totalCost of 0 with sampleCount > 0 renders as a real $0.00, not as the empty state.
Existing InvestmentPanel empty-state tests are updated to the new no-spend branch; new tests cover populated rendering, undefined costPerShip, and real-zero vs empty distinction.
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes.
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/entities/agent/api/cost-rollup.ts + barrel export + rewritten InvestmentPanel.tsx + updated/added tests
tasks.notes: Follow design.md D5 (hook placement in entities/agent, not entities/issue) and D6 InvestmentPanel section. Mirror useQualityMetrics / useCompletionTrend patterns. The formatCost helper is used for display; if it does not yet exist, add a small formatter consistent with WorkflowSessionsPanel currency handling.

tasks.title: Frontend: wire today-cost into factory-status headline
tasks.description: Extend FactoryStatusFields.todayCost from `undefined` to `{ amount: number | null; currency: string | null; sampleCount: number } | undefined`, thread useCostRollup() into FactoryStatusHeadline alongside useIssues/useAgentStatus, pass the rollup's todayCost through deriveFactoryStatus, and replace the factory-cost-reserved block with: sampleCount === 0 renders — (no-data placeholder); sampleCount > 0 renders formatCost(amount, currency) (yielding $0.00 for a genuine zero). Update the model, the headline UI, and the placeholder tests.
acceptanceCriteria: FactoryStatusFields.todayCost is typed as { amount: number | null; currency: string | null; sampleCount: number } | undefined (no longer bare undefined).
FactoryStatusHeadline calls useCostRollup() and passes todayCost into deriveFactoryStatus.
When the rollup returns todayCost with sampleCount > 0, the headline today-cost field displays formatCost(amount, currency) (spec scenario 'Today-cost field is populated from the rollup endpoint').

When the rollup returns the empty/zero-sample todayCost (sampleCount === 0), the field renders an em-dash — placeholder, not a numeric zero (spec scenario 'Empty today-cost is distinct from a zero value').

When the rollup returns a genuine todayCost of 0 with sampleCount > 0, the field renders $0.00, distinguishable from the empty placeholder (spec scenario 'Genuine zero today-cost renders as a real zero').
The runner-online, in-flight, awaiting-approval, and today-shipped fields continue to render their real values unchanged.
The factory-cost-reserved testid is removed or repurposed; existing FactoryStatusHeadline.test.tsx and factory-status.test.ts placeholder assertions are updated to the new behavior.
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes.
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/widgets/factory-status model + UI + deriveFactoryStatus today-cost threading + updated tests
tasks.notes: Follow design.md D6 factory-status section. The useCostRollup hook from T-002 is reused (not re-created). The — rendering is preserved only for the no-sample case; the 'reserved' semantics are replaced by real data. deriveFactoryStatus must carry the todayCost metric through without collapsing sampleCount.
